target_customer: Primary care clinics and ministries of health in low and middle income countries treating cervical precancer
problem: Most clinics worldwide lack infrastructure to treat cervical precancer because gas-based cryoablation needs bulky consumable cryogen. Ananya builds a portable, battery-powered closed-loop cryoablation device.
business_model: medical device sales (CRCL System), not yet cleared by FDA

founders.name: Anu Parvatiyar
education: Georgia Tech, biomedical engineering and economics
founders.background_notes: Medical device engineer turned public health technologist per YC page; employers and education per search summary of startupintros profile, not opened directly.

founders.name: Julie Yip
founders.background_notes: Listed as cofounder on the company website; not on the YC page.

investors: American Cancer Society BrightEdge Venture Fund

competitors.name: CryoPop (Jhpiego)
competitors.what: Dry-ice CO2 cryotherapy device using one tenth of the CO2 per procedure
competitors.traction_then: Phase 1 study in the Philippines and trial in India

competitors.name: Standard CO2 cryotherapy units
competitors.what: Gas-based cryotherapy recommended by WHO for low resource settings; a 50 lb tank treats 10 to 15 patients

technical_complexity.rationale: A battery-powered closed-loop cryoablation device that reaches a 5mm freeze depth needs hardware engineering and regulatory clearance.

defensibility.rationale: Medical device clearance and thermal engineering make fast copying hard, though the company is still pre-clearance.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competing low resource devices existed but no incumbent acquired or copied Ananya through 2026.

market_need_then: WHO targets elimination of cervical cancer and recommends cryotherapy in low resource settings, yet consumable gas is a barrier; the company states 80 percent of clinics worldwide lack capacity to treat early.

identity.voice_and_tone: freeze cervical cancer in its tracks; #EndCervicalCancer

branding.community_and_virality: Mission-driven global health audience; support from ACS and NCI; no merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: A mission-led brand in a niche field; little brand-specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Ananya is a small hardware company that has funded development mostly from grants and impact investors, including a $2.3M NCI SBIR grant in September 2024 and an ACS strategic investment in June 2025. It aims for FDA clearance and a 2026 launch; no clearance, exit or failure was found. Slow device timelines and small raises are the main risks.
notes: Aggregators conflict on totals (about $570K to $3.08M) and a Form D shows about $404K sold in May 2026 plus a headline of $100K in Sept 2026 (headline only); not recorded as rounds. eha $25K SAFE (May 2022) is from Seedtable, an aggregator, and unverified. eha $150K is reported by ThisDay and Guardian Nigeria. Standard CO2 cryotherapy source is a patent filing with an unclear date, used for background.
